picker.picker_modern: Departures with disruptions and lift status
picker.picker_retro: LED display like the ones at Wiener Linien stations
picker.picker_route: Next connection from A to B, with time to spare at each change

editor.header_pick_side_hint: Tap a side, then fill it in below
editor.no_lines_hint: Lines appear as soon as this stop reports departures.
editor.text_placeholder: e.g. name of the next station
editor.walk_time_aria: Walking time in minutes for line {line} towards {towards}
editor.walk_time_branching_hint: Applies to every terminus in this direction
editor.walk_time_hint: Hides departures that would leave without you. Empty = no filter.

modern.stale_feed_detail: Wiener Linien is sending out-of-date departure times for this stop. Departures return automatically once live data resumes.
modern.stale_feed_partial: Some lines aren't reporting current times.
modern.version_update: Wiener Linien Austria updated to v{v} — please reload
modern.version_reload_stuck: Reload didn't pick up the new version. Close this browser tab and reopen the dashboard, or clear your browser's site data for Home Assistant.
modern.entity_missing: Sensor {entity} no longer exists. Pick a different sensor, or remove it from this card's stops.
modern.qr_dialog_hint: Scan with your phone — opens the stop in your maps app.

editor.colors_empty_hint: Pick stops on the Stops tab — their lines will show up here.
editor.colors_hint: Optional. Without an override the official line colour applies.
editor.hide_attribution_helper: When on, the data-source credit is hidden.
editor.hide_header_helper: When on, the card title bar is hidden.
editor.layout_requires: Only takes effect with two or more stops.
editor.show_cooling_helper: Shows a snowflake beside departures with an air-conditioned vehicle. Wiener Linien report this per vehicle — older trains and trams don't send it.
editor.show_delay_colors_helper: Turns the countdown number red when a departure runs late and green when it runs early.

editor.housing_helper: Dark bezel around the LED panel with a subtle glass reflection on top.
editor.line_stripe_helper: A 4 px coloured bar at the left edge of each row, matched to the line.
editor.message_ticker_helper: Runs a custom message across the display every 5 minutes.
editor.platform_side_helper: Default follows Wiener Linien signage (platform 2 on the left, otherwise right). Override manually if needed.
editor.show_header_helper: Master switch. Per-side settings are kept.
editor.show_line_pill_helper: Renders the line code as a filled badge in the line colour rather than plain text.
editor.show_unit_helper: Trail each countdown number with a small amber "min" caption.

retro.entity_missing: Sensor {entity} no longer exists. Pick a different sensor in the entity selector above.
retro.version_reload_stuck: Reload didn't pick up the new version. Close this browser tab and reopen the dashboard, or clear your browser's site data for Home Assistant.
retro.version_update: Retro card updated to v{v} — please reload

flap.version_update: Flap card updated to v{v} — please reload
flap.version_reload_stuck: Reload didn't pick up the new version. Close this browser tab and reopen the dashboard, or clear your browser's site data for Home Assistant.
flap.entity_missing: Sensor {entity} no longer exists. Pick a different sensor in the entity selector above.

editor.hide_attribution_helper: When on, the CC-BY credit at the bottom of the card is hidden. The Wiener Linien Open Government Data licence requires visible attribution unless you keep the credit elsewhere on the dashboard.
editor.housing_helper: Wraps the board in the cabinet with a soft inset bevel and drop shadow. Cabinet colour follows your HA theme (cream on light, dark on dark). When off, the board sits flush against the dashboard.
editor.max_rows_helper: How many departures to show on the board (1–8). Merged across all stops, sorted by countdown.
editor.show_accessibility_helper: Add a wheelchair pictogram tile next to step-free departures.
editor.show_header_helper: Master switch. Per-side settings are kept.
editor.show_line_column_helper: Shows the column carrying the line code. Turn it off when the board only ever shows one line.
editor.show_min_unit_helper: Small label next to the countdown number, like real station boards.
editor.show_platform_helper: Adds a per-row platform tile between the destination and the countdown. Only shown when at least one visible row has a platform value.
editor.show_station_name_helper: Coloured band with the station name and current time at the top of the card.
editor.station_bg_helper: Default is the colour of the first tracked line (e.g. red for U1, orange for U3). On multi-line boards you can pick a specific line, or override with solid white or black.

route.no_trips_detail: The trip planner found nothing. The next update tries again.
route.unavailable_detail: Connections come back as soon as it answers.
route.entity_missing: Sensor {entity} no longer exists. Pick another route in the editor.
route.version_update: Route card updated to v{v} — please reload
route.version_reload_stuck: Reloading didn't pick up the new version. Close this browser tab and open the dashboard again, or clear the site data for Home Assistant in your browser settings.
route.adhoc_pick: Pick an origin and a destination
route.adhoc_pick_detail: The next connections show up once both are set.
route.adhoc_no_trips_detail: Try another stop, or try again later.
route.adhoc_stale: Too many route requests right now, so this is a slightly older plan.
route.adhoc_no_match: No matching stop. Pick a suggestion from the list.
route.adhoc_matches_more: Showing {shown} of {total}. Keep typing to narrow it down.
route.adhoc_error_same_stop: Origin and destination are the same stop
route.adhoc_error_rate_limited: Too many route requests right now
route.adhoc_error_not_loaded_detail: Set up a stop or a route in the integration. The card checks again every minute.
route.adhoc_error_too_close: These stops are too close together
route.adhoc_error_stop_unknown: The trip planner doesn't know this stop
route.adhoc_error_no_timetable_detail: The card checks again in a few minutes.
route.adhoc_error_refused: The trip planner can't plan this trip
route.not_a_route: This is a departure board, not a route. Pick a route in the editor.

editor.entity_helper: Leave empty to pick origin and destination right on the card. Only routes you've set up are listed.
editor.title: Heading
editor.alternatives_helper: How many later connections to list under the best one. 0 hides them.
editor.show_map_pins_helper: A pin after each boarding stop and the destination opens that stop on the city map.
editor.hide_attribution_helper: The Wiener Linien OGD licence requires a visible credit unless it appears elsewhere on the dashboard.
editor.no_routes: No route set up yet. You can pick origin and destination right on the card, or set up a fixed route.
editor.from_helper: Applies until someone picks another stop on this device.
editor.to_helper: Applies until someone picks another stop on this device.
editor.step_free_helper: Only connections with lifts or ramps instead of stairs and escalators, and with low-floor vehicles.
